about_the_game:
Your life, your choices—now face the Judgement.

What happens when the story of your life is laid bare? In Judgement, a narrative-driven visual novel, you find yourself in the afterlife, where your every action, decision, and intention is weighed. The choices you made in life echo here, where truth is the only currency—and the consequences are eternal.

But how can the guardians judge who you truly were without knowing the real you? Their solution: send you back.

Each guardian will transport you to a fictitious Earth scenario—crafted to test your moral compass. One moment, you’re on a date at a restaurant; the next, you’re making a life-altering decision in a hospital hallway. With each choice, you reveal more of your nature. Upon returning, the guardians evaluate your actions before guiding you to the next trial.

Will you seek redemption, cling to your regrets, or defy the forces that pass final judgment? The outcome is in your hands.

Key Features:

  • Interactive Storytelling: Your decisions shape the narrative, with multiple paths and endings.

  • Moral Dilemmas: Face tough choices that challenge your understanding of right and wrong.

  • Fictitious Earth Scenarios: Experience immersive, lifelike situations designed to test your character.

  • Haunting Atmosphere: Explore a mysterious afterlife where every moment feels like a revelation.

  • Compelling Characters: Encounter enigmatic guardians who will test your resolve, and reveal truths you might wish stayed buried.

Life is over. But your story isn’t. The Judgement awaits.
detailed_description:
Just Updated

We’re excited to share some news: Guardians of the Afterlife has a new name 'Judgement'.

Why the change? As development progressed, we realized the heart of the story isn’t about the guardians themselves, but about the experience of facing the consequences of your life’s choices. Each decision you make in the afterlife shapes your journey as you step into fictitious Earth scenarios and uncover deeper truths about yourself.

The game you’ve been looking forward to remains the same, a rich, narrative-driven experience of mystery, morality, and self-discovery. Now, with a title that reflects the core of the story more than ever before.

Your life. Your choices. Now face the Judgement.
